purpose: Separate ordinary shortlist coverage from one-incumbent repair using calibrated five-candidate competition

dataset.replication: Twenty exact matching-text clones per family, not 100 independent linguistic cases
dataset.noise: Flexible queries concatenate company aliases; identifier strings deliberately collide. These are assignment diagnostics, not clean unique-identifier entity data.
dataset.isolation: AND(country, competition_group); original rows share background tag, custom groups have private tags. Original matching fields unchanged. Each custom block has exactly five A candidates.
dataset.oracle: Repair families have one complete feasible bijection forced by four constrained queries. Ambiguous groups allow every bijection. Unrepairable flexible queries are known negatives; no arbitrary unique oracle for ambiguous records.

calibration_gate: Real baseline/ONNX score_pool logs must verify every custom edge, exclusive constrained queries and escape ranks. Check custom-only probe and full combined dataset before starting any measured run. No synthetic vectors or surrogate scoring.

measurement.controls: Same B bytes/path for all eight combinations within each permutation; same prepared combined-data vector/index cache bytes; fresh crossmaps/outputs; sequential processes only
measurement.ordering: Rotate top_n setting order and alternate/balance binary order; preserve exact sequence in run metadata
measurement.timing: Application subprocess wall/RSS only; exclude calibration, preparation, copies and analysis. Disable scoring logs for measured runs.
measurement.stopping: Complete all planned combinations. No result-based exclusions, no dataset tuning after freeze. Stop and report integrity failures without silently discarding/repeating measured runs.

expected_diagnostics.repair_families: With escape rank r, experimental full correct matching is expected only when top_n>=r; below r the free alternative is unavailable. Ordinary main matching can succeed depending on claim order; do not require it to fail every run.
expected_diagnostics.ambiguous: All assignments within group are acceptable; wider lists can improve coverage in both binaries. At full width five, ordinary matching completes without needing repair; identity repeatability is not guaranteed.
expected_diagnostics.unrepairable: Full threshold graph maximum is four; no legal one-to-two repair. Known-negative acceptance can still vary with ordinary greedy order; no claim that larger lists improve this cohort's accuracy.
expected_diagnostics.background: Report separately; do not dilute custom-group effects into whole-dataset numbers. Frozen background source fields, but ANN100 and narrower top_n differ from earlier studies so do not pool their results.
expected_diagnostics.late_width: Use actual reassignment WAL ranks to establish whether fifth-ranked alternatives were used, not just improved counts.

analysis: Per family and background: automatic counts, known/allowed identity quality, known-negative acceptance, stable assignments and mean pairwise changed B including no-auto states, local moves/replacement ranks, full-run timing/RSS. First-pass descriptive analysis; do not treat cloned groups or pairwise comparisons as independent inferential samples.
integrity: All subprocess exits, no skipped B, active outcomes reconcile, bijective crossmaps, independent WAL fold, in-group candidates, source/input/binary/cache hashes and warm-cache evidence
